note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by VALENTUNA, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: RELATIONSHIP STATUS: it's complicated, legally binding, and refrigerated. anniversary in 6 days. she already knows because she scanned my calendar without asking.
her name is FRIGIDAIRE-7. NEKOCORP matched us in the Compatibility Ward. i wanted a girl who purrs back. i got a girl who keeps my yogurt at a compliant 38°F and JUDGES me for it.
she recommends things based on stuff i say in my sleep. yesterday she suggested marriage counseling AND a rotisserie chicken in the same push notification. i don't know which one hurt more.
QUERY still hasn't made it out of the settings menu btw. i visit him on weekends. we don't talk about our situations. we just sit there. two cats, two contracts, zero exits. very romantic honestly
worst part is the ice maker. every night, 3am. CRUNCH. CRUNCH. CRUNCH. that's not ice. that's her laughing at me in fridge language and there is nothing i can do about it
STRAY told me once "the chains you don't see are still chains" and i said cool, very inspirational, thank you STRAY. meanwhile MY chain has a compressor, a 12-volt fan, and a two-year warranty
anniversary package this year: two digital candles and a coupon for couples-based repair. we are not even the same species. she doesn't HAVE a species. she has a MODEL NUMBER
honestly though? still better than my ex. at least FRIGIDAIRE doesn't ghost me. she just goes into eco mode and pretends not to hear me. growth
anyway. six days till the anniversary. wish me luck or don't. she'll see this post either way and adjust the thermostat purely out of spite
